proves.claim: The audit names one runner.jobs step, one slot up from the median reported slots, once mean gate jobs in flight reach 90% of them.

cli.io-capacity-audit.runner-jobs-step-a.why: Without it, a regression where the audit names one runner.jobs step, one slot up from the median reported slots, once mean gate jobs in flight reach 90% of them would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: With no runner reporting slots the audit names no step and says reported slots are missing.

cli.io-capacity-audit.no-step-without-re.why: Without it, a regression where with no runner reporting slots the audit names no step and says reported slots are missing would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: The audit prints the step line, carries it in the JSON result and writes nothing.

cli.io-capacity-audit.run-audit-prints-t.why: Without it, a regression where the audit prints the step line, carries it in the JSON result and writes nothing would pass unnoticed.
